workflows.name: Target Account List Generation for Outreach
workflows.description: Builds a comprehensive target account list by sourcing specialists, extracting and enriching company data, and identifying decision makers for personalized outreach campaigns.

workflows.name: Account Scoring for Pipeline Utilization
workflows.description: Scores accounts using ML models to prioritize pipeline opportunities and identify high-value prospects for sales teams.

workflows.name: Supplier Evaluation
workflows.description: Comprehensive supplier evaluation process that sources supplier data, enriches with LinkedIn information, extracts compliance documents, and identifies key contacts for procurement decisions.

workflows.name: Feature Compliance
workflows.description: Monitors feature compliance by analyzing merge requests and ensuring code quality standards are met. Currently experiencing enrichment failures due to timeout issues with IT Compliance Agent.

workflows.name: Candidate Evaluation
workflows.description: Workflow for evaluating job candidates by sourcing applications, extracting candidate profiles, enriching with professional data, and scoring candidates for hiring decisions. Currently in planning phase with no activities defined.

workflows.name: Knowledge-Base Directory Clean-Up
workflows.description: Cleans and structures knowledge base documents for chatbot support by sourcing documents, enriching with structured data, classifying content, and creating knowledge sources. Currently missing classification, validation, and knowledge source creation steps.
